Mia, I’m so sorry I went quiet after you first messaged. That’s on me. You don’t need to apologise for yesterday or for any of this. I’m here now, and you’re not dealing with it on your own.

I’m off all day tomorrow now Sam’s taken my shift. I’ll bring Dad’s trailer over and we can get everything out of Priya’s garage before her mum gets there. You and whatever you want to keep can come straight back to mine — Ruby says the couch is yours for as long as you want it. Only warning: Clover will absolutely try to sleep on you. Just tell me what time to come.
---
To: @mia

Tully’s also lined up the Lantern Room for Sat 28th for a benefit gig, with all the door money going to you. Hollow Pines are keen to play too, and obviously Soft Servo. Jono’s cousin has an old Yamaha keyboard you can have while we work out the Nord situation. It’s not a Nord, but it works.

You drove all the way to Gatton at 2am when my car died after Toowoomba and didn’t make a fuss, so please don’t feel like you’re putting anyone out now. We’ve got you.
---
To: @mia

And please don’t quit the band or bolt back to Rocky because of this week. If you still want to go once things have settled, that’s a different conversation, but don’t make that call while everything’s smashed and you’ve got nowhere to sleep. Your songs are the best thing we do. The notebooks being ruined is fucking horrible, but when you’re ready we can sit down and rebuild whatever you can remember, no deadline.

Your landlord’s portal response is a joke, by the way. One thing at a time. What time tomorrow?
